MDAnalysis preparation and active jobs


__LESSONS__

API attempt time
Latest retained native attempt per API; generation plus local testing. It is not total lifetime time or provider time alone.
Measured retry intervals
Instrumented interval from the preceding provider end to the next provider start; includes queue/cooldown. Missing history is unavailable, not zero.



Proposal only · not launched
Can an error-only document-repair comparison fit?


Recommended pilot: mir_eval
Two independently initialized arms from the same A2 README and the same 13 failed APIs. Error-only versus source-informed repair; then 148 fresh zero-fix evaluations per arm.
Planning allowance: 4–7 hours, including implementation, leakage checks, execution and analysis. This is an engineering estimate, not a measured forecast; long provider failures can exceed it.
Protect the Wednesday report
Do not promise the full three-repository ablation. Repeating both arms has about 10.6 hours of retained-work analogy before engineering, restarts, contention and reporting.
Freeze evidence by Wednesday 9 AM for report assembly. A single paired run is exploratory; “equally well” requires a predefined equivalence margin and adequate repeated measurements.


Isolation and acceptance requirements
  • Source-free prompts receive only the starting README, failed snippet/error and common harness/input contract.
  • No source windows, test excerpts, deep-dive output or source-derived repair hints reach the error-only model.
  • Run both arms on the same versioned harness, model settings, manifest, fixtures, document-round budget and stopping rule.
  • Use separate worktrees and mutable outputs with the existing shared Gemini gate; preserve original native results.
  • Compare per-API paired outcomes, regressions, repair rounds, provider attempts and cost. Do not treat reuse of old v3 source results plus a new v4 error-only run as a clean matched experiment.
  • Predefine the time cap, incomplete-arm handling and final-report cutoff before starting.

Provenance and interpretation limits
This is a passive snapshot. No model calls, test execution, repair, or job restarts are performed by this dashboard. Each input file is hashed below. The HTML embeds its data and works offline; download charts as SVG for sharing.
Current A2/B2 effects are descriptive and single-run. RDPro is historical context with different strata and review methods. MDAnalysis v4 progress is reported separately; missing measurements remain missing. Provider failures and missing dependencies do not establish that documentation caused a failure.
